topic: Move Semantics and Ownership Transfer with Unique Pointers
explanation: In advanced C++ programming, especially when managing resources efficiently, understanding move semantics and ownership transfer is crucial. Unique pointers (std::unique_ptr) enforce exclusive ownership of dynamically allocated resources, preventing accidental copies and enabling safe transfer of resource ownership through move semantics. This technique is used to optimize performance by avoiding unnecessary deep copies and to ensure resource safety in complex systems.
